definitions.gloss: to fall down, to tumble, to trip
definitions.explanation: To fall down, especially by tripping or losing balance. Very common in casual and children's speech.

examples.japanese: {石|いし}につまずいてこけた。
examples.english: I tripped on a stone and fell.

examples.japanese: {走|はし}っていたらこけて{膝|ひざ}をすりむいた。
examples.english: I fell while running and scraped my knee.

notes:
KANJI: Can be written as {転|こ}ける.

TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive.

REGIONAL NOTE: More common in Western Japan (Kansai region). In Eastern Japan (Kanto), {転|ころ}ぶ is more common.

CONJUGATION: Despite ending in -eru, this is an ichidan (vowel-stem) verb: こけない, こけます, こけて, etc.

RELATED WORDS:
- {転|ころ}ぶ (to fall - more standard/Eastern)
- {倒|たお}れる (to fall over, collapse - larger scale)
